thread:
laura_cs: quick synthesis from the Aurora Health onboarding call (45m) — dropping raw asks and immediate next steps. overall tone: excited but finance + security teams hit blockers.

laura_cs: headline: 4 concrete asks tied to their procurement timeline (end of quarter). If we don't deliver a clearer cost attribution + export options they said renewal conversation will be delayed.

emily_success_ops: noted. they emphasized a single-month reconciliation issue that stops their procurement group from approving expansion.

laura_cs: raw asks captured (copied from meeting notes):
- Environment-level cost view: want breakdown by environment (dev/stage/prod) and by project. severity: high. workaround: they currently tag invoices manually and cross-reference logs. impact: blocks scaling to additional teams.
- Token budget alerts: notify when a project exceeds budget threshold with estimated overspend. severity: medium-high. workaround: manual daily checks + ad-hoc scripts.
- Scheduled export pipeline: daily S3 dump CSV/ndjson with fields (environment, route, tokens, cost_estimate, user_id). severity: medium. workaround: API pulls + stitching.
- Scoped SSO roles for billing: ability to create read-only "billing reviewer" role limited to billing views only. severity: medium. workaround: org-level SSO groups mapped outside product.

jamal_product: thanks laura. can we prioritize which of these are likely to unblock their procurement? my read: env-level cost + scheduled export seem highest impact. token alerts would be nice-to-have.

laura_cs: correct — procurement explicitly asked for "per-environment billing view or an automated daily export so our finance team can ingest into our GL." they said a one-off CSV would get them over the line short-term.

ryan_eng: feasibility quick take:
- Env-level cost UI: needs attribution changes + small UX surface. backend attribution is the heavy part. estimate: M-L (4-6 wks) for full UI + accurate attribution.
- Daily export to S3 (CSV/ndjson): straightforward; can reuse our export worker and add fields. estimate: S (5-7d) to ship an MVP.
- Token budget alerts: requires metrics pipeline + alerting rule UI; estimate: M (2-3 sprints) depending on level of integration.
- Billing-role SSO scoping: mostly auth mapping + frontend exposure; estimate: S-M (~2 wks).

jamal_product: proposal: ship daily export MVP first as a targeted piece to unblock procurement (S). then plan env-level UI in the next cycle. @ryan_eng can you confirm the S3 export will include cost_estimate field (even if approximate)?

ryan_eng: yes we can include a cost_estimate using current unit rates; mark as provisional in the header. we'll include model_id, route, env, tokens, timestamp, cost_estimate, request_id.

emily_success_ops: client follow-up ask: sample file mapping to their GL codes would be helpful. they offered to share their mapping template so we can align field names.

laura_cs: i'll request their mapping template and small sample export they currently produce. also scheduled a follow-up call next Tue to demo the export CSV once we have MVP.

infra-bot: created task "exports/daily-s3-aurora-mvp" and uploaded stub CSV "aurora_sample_export_2026-03-22.csv" (uploaded).

jamal_product: perfect. next steps:
1) Ryan to spin up export MVP branch and estimate final timeline.
2) Laura to collect their GL mapping + sample CSV.
3) Jamal to create a short epic for "env-billing-story" and tag finance-product for acceptance criteria.

laura_cs: adding the recording link and the whiteboard snapshot to this thread: https://redwood.example.com/recordings/aurora-onboard-2026-03-22 and uploaded "aurora_whiteboard_03-22.png"

ryan_eng: will start a spike today for the export worker; i expect a PR in ~4d.

jamal_product: thanks team — aim is to have the MVP export in their S3 by EOW next week so Aurora can ingest and start reconciliation. will update this thread when epic exists. :rocket:
